about.title: Between code and *camera*.
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Engineer based in Mexico City. For more than a decade I've built web, desktop and mobile products, and lately I've focused on fintech: currency exchange, SPEI transfers, debit cards and identity verification.
I've led and coached teams as Tech Lead and Team Coach. I care that code stays maintainable, that reviews add value and that every release reaches production without surprises.
When I'm not coding, I'm behind a camera. Photography taught me patience, how to frame what matters and how to cut what doesn't, and I apply the same thinking to software.
about.interests: Photography, film, astronomy, running and literature.

independent-engineer.title: Independent Software Engineer
highlights: Designed and built [Slabs: Sliding Puzzle](slabs) end to end with Flutter and a BLoC architecture. Launched on Google Play, with the App Store release coming soon.
Built websites for clients: [Smile Too](smiletoo) (dental clinic), [Raíz Intelligence Lab](raiz-intelligence-lab) (research consultancy) and [RehabSport](rehabsportmed) (sports medicine).

uexchange-senior-mobile.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
highlights: Built the end-to-end currency exchange (buy/sell) flow with multi-currency wallet sync and quote-rate updates under time-critical windows.
Created an exchange-rate threshold control with an interactive selector and estimated-execution-time indicators that prevent input errors before confirmation.
Developed the interbank deposits and withdrawals module (SPEI) with reactive state management and server-synced pagination.
Built debit card onboarding and lifecycle on Galileo Financial, with real-time pause, resume and cancel controls.
Integrated the Truora SDK for KYC, auto-filling address, tax ID and dates from scanned IDs and streamlining contract signing.

vest-senior-software.title: Senior Software Engineer · Mobile & Web
highlights: Developed the SPEI deposits and withdrawals module, driving a 70% increase in investment deposits in Mexico.
Integrated Smartlook, Customer.io and Adjust, giving business teams attribution and behavior data to improve retention.
Led core features: debit card onboarding with an external issuer, Stock Lending dashboards, transaction views and Google/Apple sign-in.
Built the corporate website from scratch: SEO-first, trilingual (ES/EN/PT) on a CMS, with a WebSocket-powered AI chat.
Maintained the mobile and web CI/CD pipelines, including automatic app signing, keeping releases fast and reliable.

nuxiba-tech-lead.title: Tech Lead
highlights: Directed the engineering team through the product roadmap, aligning delivery with business goals.
Set code quality standards and technical governance, leading architecture decisions and reviews.
Designed the CI/CD strategy that reduced production errors and sped up releases.

nuxiba-team-coach.title: Team Coach
highlights: Led and coached a team of 5 engineers with agile practices, raising engagement and project visibility.

nuxiba-developer.title: Software Developer → Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Full-stack development of web and desktop solutions with real-time communication (sockets/WebSockets), VoIP, speech recognition and text-to-speech.
